how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official IGNOU website at www.ignou.ac.in or http://rcnagpur.ignou.ac.in/.
Fill in all the required details in the application form accurately.
Attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications, testimonials, vigilance clearance certificate, last pay certificate, and experience certificates.
Write "Application for the engagement of Administrative Associate Regional Centre, IGNOU" in capital letters on the top of the envelope.
Send the complete application by post or deliver it to the Regional Director, IGNOU, Regional Centre, 14, Hindustan Colony, Amravati Road, Nagpur-440 033 on or before 26.10.2026.
important_instructions: The terms of appointment are initially for a period of six months and further extendable on a performance basis up to a maximum of two years or up to attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier. Services can be discontinued or terminated without assigning any reason thereof. Merely fulfilling educational qualifications and experience does not entitle a person to be called for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Selected candidates must not divulge or disclose information pertaining to university matters outside the university. Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) of data or proceedings shall remain the property of the university. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained. Candidates shall never claim for a regular appointment in the university on the basis of this engagement.

faq.question: Q1. What is IGNOU Administrative Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment notification issued by IGNOU Regional Centre Nagpur to engage 2 Administrative Associates on a full-time basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IGNOU Administrative Associate?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Administrative Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IGNOU Administrative Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete offline application is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IGNOU Administrative Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized university or organisation, along with a minimum of 2 years of experience and knowledge of MS Office.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IGNOU Administrative Associate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 30,000/- per month.
